name: Exercise — Fire / Evacuation Drill (2 Hours)
description: A short practical evacuation drill for buildings or facilities. Covers alarm activation, evacuation, assembly, accountability, and debrief. Suitable for office buildings, schools, hospitals, or industrial sites.

groups.name: Floor Wardens
groups.description: Designated evacuation wardens per floor or zone

roles.name: Safety Officer
roles.description: Initiates drill, monitors execution, leads debrief

roles.name: Floor Warden
roles.description: Guides evacuation of assigned zone, confirms all-clear

roles.name: Observer
roles.description: Times evacuation, notes issues, counts personnel

events.title: Safety Officer Pre-Brief
events.description: Brief floor wardens and observers. Confirm assembly points and head-count procedures.

events.title: ALARM ACTIVATED — Drill Begins
events.description: Fire alarm activated. Evacuation commences. Start timer.

events.title: Evacuation In Progress
events.description: All personnel evacuate to designated assembly points via assigned routes.

events.title: Head Count at Assembly Point
events.description: Floor wardens conduct head count and report to Safety Officer.

events.title: ALL CLEAR — Drill Concluded
events.description: Safety Officer confirms all personnel accounted for. Alarm silenced.

events.title: Return to Building
events.description: Personnel return to workstations in orderly fashion.

events.title: Observer Reports Collected
events.description: Observers submit timing data, issues noted, and improvement suggestions.

events.title: Debrief & Lessons Learned
events.description: Review evacuation time, issues found, and improvements for next drill.
